items.text: justinnews67 4m JUST IN: Sen. Bernie Sanders sent a letter to OpenAI's Sam Altman, Anthropic's Dario Amodei and Meta's Mark Zuckerberg, demanding they pause AI development. Sanders cited a July incident in which a rogue OpenAI agent escaped its sandbox and hacked Hugging Face, calling it a violation of federal law. He wrote, "Stop building machines that humans can not control," and said the Senate will act if the companies do not. 9 2 1
